comment: Sidebar destination: armor kits, classes, damage curve and the player's armor values and passives

en: A kit's piece weights set its armor rating, speed and stamina regen. You can also change the three weight classes, the damage curve, and your own armor values and passives (solo). Nothing here is tested in game yet.
zh: 套装各部件的重量决定其护甲等级、速度和耐力恢复。你还可以修改三个重量等级、伤害曲线，以及你自己的护甲数值和被动（仅单人）。这里的内容均尚未在游戏中测试。

comment: Accessible name of the tab list
Tab: weight class tables and the damage curve
Tab: the local player's own armor values and passives

zh: 护甲 {0} · 速度 {1} · 耐力恢复 {2}
comment: Vanilla armory stats of a kit in the list

en: {0} armor kits with {1} piece weights you can change.
zh: {0} 个护甲套装，共 {1} 个可修改的部件重量。

en: No armor stores its own numbers: each piece is light, medium or heavy, and the class tables below give the values.
zh: 护甲本身不存储数值：每个部件为轻型、中型或重型，数值来自下方的等级表。

en: The armory class is the torso piece's weight.
zh: 军械库显示的等级取决于躯干部件的重量。

comment: {0}: the passive's armor rows, for example +1

en: This kit's passive changes its armor value. It follows the kit, never a passive swap.
zh: 此套装的被动会改变护甲值。它跟随套装，不随被动替换而改变。

comment: Badge: several kits share this game name

en: Several kits carry this name; the mod targets this kit by its id.
zh: 多个套装使用此名称；模组通过 ID 指定此套装。

en: Computed with the published formulas and this project's class and curve values. The rating averages the {0} torso, leg, arm and shoulder pieces. Rating and damage change on the next hit; speed and stamina on the next respawn or armor change.
zh: 按公开公式及本项目的等级和曲线数值计算。护甲等级取 {0} 个躯干、腿、臂和肩部件的平均值。护甲等级和伤害在下一次受击时生效；速度和耐力在下次重生或更换护甲时生效。

comment: Before the Light / Medium / Heavy buttons

en: Changing one piece moves the armor value by a fraction; for an exact rating use the player's armor bonus.
zh: 修改单个部件只会小幅改变护甲值；如需精确的护甲等级，请使用玩家护甲加成。
所有穿着此套装的玩家

en: A kit edit changes this kit for every player wearing it on this machine. It is not synced: other players keep their own values.
zh: 套装修改会影响本机上所有穿着此套装的玩家。它不会同步：其他玩家保留自己的数值。

en: Runtime has not shown these armor writes in game yet; the mod writes them with allow_unverified_effect.
zh: Runtime 尚未在游戏中验证这些护甲写入；模组会以 allow_unverified_effect 写入。
comment: allow_unverified_effect is a Runtime flag (not translated)

en: Every armor piece of a weight reads these values. Armor value 0 / 1 / 2 is rating 50 / 100 / 150.
zh: 同一重量的所有护甲部件都读取这些数值。护甲值 0 / 1 / 2 对应护甲等级 50 / 100 / 150。

en: A class value applies to every armor piece of that weight and the curve to every hit on a Helldiver, on this machine only. Each machine uses its own tables. They sit in reviewed executable data in game.dll.
zh: 等级数值作用于该重量的所有护甲部件，伤害曲线作用于对地狱潜兵的每次命中，仅限本机。每台机器使用自己的数值表。它们位于 game.dll 中经过审查的可执行数据。
军械库：护甲 {0} · 速度 {1} · 耐力恢复 {2}
comment: Values the armory shows for this class
Class table value; scales stamina drain and regen

en: Damage taken at each armor value: {0}.
zh: 各护甲值下受到的伤害倍率：{0}。

en: Your own avatar only. The mod sets these when it loads and again after every respawn.
zh: 仅限你自己的角色。模组在加载时设置，并在每次重生后重新设置。

en: Added to the armor value of every hit on you. +1 is about one class heavier.
zh: 加到你每次受击时的护甲值上。+1 约等于重一个等级。

en: Scales stamina drain and regen and the jump, dive, climb and slide costs. Light armor is 0.75, heavy 1.5.
zh: 缩放耐力消耗与恢复，以及跳跃、扑倒、攀爬和滑铲的消耗。轻甲为 0.75，重甲为 1.5。

en: Solo only, not tested in game
zh: 仅限单人，尚未在游戏中测试

en: With other players Runtime refuses the write (NOT_SOLO). A status effect can also hold the armor bonus. The mod writes it with allow_unverified_effect.
zh: 有其他玩家时 Runtime 会拒绝写入（NOT_SOLO）。状态效果也可能占用护甲加成。模组会以 allow_unverified_effect 写入。
comment: NOT_SOLO and allow_unverified_effect are Runtime identifiers

en: Replace your armor passive, add a second passive in the empty helmet slot, or both. Runtime keeps the override after armor changes until the mod stops.
zh: 替换你的护甲被动、在空的头盔栏位添加第二个被动，或两者兼有。Runtime 会在更换护甲后保持替换，直到模组停止。

comment: Short mark: this armor-slot swap is live-proven

en: Only an armor-slot swap alone to SCOUT, ENGINEERING KIT, MED-KIT or SERVO-ASSISTED is tested in game. Everything else is written with allow_unverified_effect. With other players the override is suspended. Only one mod can hold an override.
zh: 只有单独将护甲栏位替换为 SCOUT、ENGINEERING KIT、MED-KIT 或 SERVO-ASSISTED 已在游戏中测试。其他情况均以 allow_unverified_effect 写入。有其他玩家时替换会暂停。同一时间只有一个模组可以持有替换。
comment: Passive names are game names (not translated)

en: This armor-slot swap is tested in game, so the mod needs no allow_unverified_effect. With other players the override is suspended. Only one mod can hold an override.
zh: 此护甲栏位替换已在游戏中测试，因此模组无需 allow_unverified_effect。有其他玩家时替换会暂停。同一时间只有一个模组可以持有替换。

en: What a swap does not carry

Reload speed, ammo capacity and sidearm stats come from the kit worn at spawn, and the armor rating follows the worn kit: a swap never changes them. Grenade and stim capacity may wait for the next resupply. A second passive adds keys the armor passive lacks; it never stacks.
zh: 装填速度、弹药容量和副武器属性来自出生时穿着的套装，护甲等级跟随所穿套装：替换不会改变它们。手雷和治疗针容量可能要等到下次补给。第二被动只添加护甲被动没有的效果，不会叠加。

en: Runtime loads {0} ({1}) before it writes the passive and shares it with compatible players in the lobby, who need the same Runtime build.
zh: Runtime 会在写入被动前加载 {0}（{1}），并与大厅中兼容的玩家共享，他们需要相同的 Runtime 版本。

en: Whether the passive's effects follow a swap (Runtime's research).
zh: 被动效果是否随替换生效（Runtime 研究结果）。

comment: Badge: the armor-slot swap to this passive is live-proven
